question: Nirmala Panikar received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award-2019 (given in February 2023) for her contribution to __________ dance form.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohiniyattam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nirmala Panikar** received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award-2019 for her contribution to **Mohiniyattam**.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award is given to artists for their outstanding contribution to the field of performing arts.
 
• **Mohiniyattam** is a classical dance form from the Indian state of Kerala.
 
• This dance form is known for its graceful movements and feminine style.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nirmala Panikar** is a renowned Mohiniyattam dancer and has significantly contributed to the preservation and promotion of this dance form.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy for Music, Dance, and Drama, recognizes and honors artists for their dedication and achievements in the field of performing arts.
 
• Mohiniyattam is traditionally performed by women and showcases themes of love and devotion, often dedicated to the Hindu god Vishnu.
 
• The dance form combines elements of Bharatanatyam and Kathakali, which are other classical dance forms from South India.
